description: This is a SCSS source file containing styles and mixins for Bootstrap-based theming, specifically for a 'SuiteP' theme within the SuiteCRM project. It defines styles for buttons, images, dropdowns, navigation bar, alerts, progress bars, list groups, panels, and wells, utilizing variables and mixins for consistency and customization.

methods.name: btn-styles
methods.description: Mixin for styling buttons with a specified background color, including hover, active, and disabled states.

methods.name: alert-styles
methods.description: Mixin for styling alert boxes with a specified color, including different severity levels.

methods.name: panel-heading-styles
methods.description: Mixin for styling panel headings with a specified color.

methods.name: progress-bar-styles
methods.description: Mixin for styling progress bars with a specified color.
